contracts.name: _default_catalog
contracts.error_policy: Return valid tuple of 25 matched-horizon SignalDescriptors
semantic_rules: Every descriptor must have target_horizon_hours matching its lookback scale

contracts.name: evaluate_signal_admission
contracts.signatures: def evaluate_signal_admission(panel: RawSignalPanel, targets: dict[int, CalibrationTarget], calibrations: tuple[SignalCalibration, ...], folds: tuple[CausalFold, ...], cost_bps_2d: NDArray[np.float32] | None, config: AdmissionConfig, rng_seed: int = 42) -> tuple[SignalAdmissionEvidence, ...]
contracts.error_policy: Raise ValueError on missing target horizon; return evidence tuple
semantic_rules: Must compute Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q-values across full vector of p-values

contracts.name: combine_admitted_forecasts
contracts.signatures: def combine_admitted_forecasts(panel: RawSignalPanel, calibrations: tuple[SignalCalibration, ...], evidence: tuple[SignalAdmissionEvidence, ...], folds: tuple[CausalFold, ...]) -> CalibratedForecastPanel
contracts.error_policy: Return zero-mu fallback if no signals admitted; scale-normalize admitted signals
semantic_rules: Must divide forecast contribution by sqrt(H / 4) to normalize to 4h return scale

assertions.output: CalibratedForecastPanel with non-zero mu_2d and non-nan se_2d
